head.h1: Party Catering Dubai — Birthdays, Yacht & Villa Celebrations

opening_paragraph: myCHEF party catering in Dubai starts at AED 120 per person for a buffet and AED 700 for a plated private-chef dinner. A vetted chef and full service team come to your venue. You host the evening while we handle every plate. The parties people remember are the ones where the host is genuinely at the party, glass in hand, mid-conversation, not stuck plating in the kitchen or hunting for one more clean tray. That is the whole idea: our team arrives early, takes over the food, the service and the setup, and hands you back your own night. A rooftop birthday as the light drops behind Marina, a slow afternoon of grazing by the pool, a cocktail night that quietly runs past midnight; tell us what you're planning and an itemised proposal lands back with you promptly during our published business hours.

new_paragraphs: Party catering with myCHEF includes menu design, a vetted chef, service staff, all equipment, setup and full cleanup — a complete party catering services package, not just trays of food dropped at the door. From the moment we arrive, the kitchen is ours: prep, cooking, plating, replenishing, and clearing every glass and tray before we leave. Where the format calls for it, we bring canapés, grazing tables and live stations, buffet or plated service, plus a bar and dessert setup styled to the room. You get a single point of contact from first enquiry to final cleanup, so nothing falls between the caterer and the venue. As the team coordinating your booking, we cover the whole evening — including the parts hosts usually dread, like washing up at 1am — so the only job left on your list is enjoying it.

Your party menu is built around your guests, not pulled off a fixed list. We start with the format — canapés and finger food catering for a standing crowd, a grazing table guests pick at all night, live cooking stations for theatre, or a plated multi-course dinner — then design the party menu dubai to suit the cuisine and the season. Arabic mezze and mixed grills, Italian and Mediterranean sharing plates, Asian and Indian spreads, or a modern European tasting run all sit comfortably here. Dietary needs are handled properly, not as an afterthought: halal by default, plus vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, nut-free and kids' options labelled on the menu. A mocktail or bar setup and a dessert table round it out. See finger food catering for lighter, canapé-led formats, or ask us to combine styles across one evening.

Wherever the party lands — a Marina high-rise, a Palm villa with the beach at the door, a rooftop terrace strung with lights, a Downtown apartment or an Emirates Hills garden — we bring party catering to the venue and shape it around the occasion, the guest count and the space you have to work with. Searching for party catering near me usually means you want a team that already knows Dubai's buildings, access rules and service lifts; ours does. Home hosts often start with private party catering built around their own guest list instead of a fixed template, while larger celebrations move to villas, rooftops and event spaces. From pool parties to cocktail parties , the same standard travels to every neighbourhood.

add_block.new_heading: How much does party catering cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Party catering in Dubai starts from AED 120 per person for a buffet, and the final party catering cost dubai moves with your guest count, your menu and how hands-on the service is. A drop-off spread starts at AED 90 a head; a premium buffet with BBQ, live stations or passed canapes starts at AED 150; a plated dinner cooked and served by a private chef at your table runs AED 700 to AED 950. Volume formats carry a minimum of 10 guests, 20 for a buffet, and a minimum order of AED 900. Passed canapés with a manned bar work out differently to a grazing table guests graze all evening. If you prefer a fixed structure, party catering packages run from AED 1,200, with larger tiers at AED 2,400, 3,600, 4,500 and 5,500 as courses, stations and staffing scale up; a chef's tasting menu is AED 1,400. There is an affordable route and a genuinely luxury one — the party menu, headcount and staffing set where you land. For the fuller picture on prices, see private chef prices and the catering price guide , or send your details for an itemised quote built around your evening. add_block.new_heading: Catering a party for 50 — what the number looks like
new_paragraphs: At 50 guests the format decides nearly everything, so start there instead of with the menu. A standard buffet works from AED 120 a head, which is where most 50-guest parties in Dubai land. Add BBQ, live stations or a passed-canape reception and you are working from AED 150. A plated dinner for 50 is a different production altogether at AED 700 to AED 950 a head, because it needs a brigade in the kitchen and a waiter for roughly every ten seated guests. Multiply the tier by 50 and add 5% VAT, and you have the food line.

Two costs sit outside that figure and both are quoted separately, because burying them is how a cheap-looking quote turns expensive. Staffing is the first: a drop-off needs nobody, a buffet needs one or two people keeping it alive across the evening, and live stations need a chef standing at each one. Rentals are the second — tables, linen, crockery, glassware and chafing equipment for 50 rarely already exist in a villa. At 50 you are far above every minimum, so the only real question is how much of the evening you want run for you.

add_block.new_heading: Small party catering, and ideas that suit a smaller room
new_paragraphs: A small party is a different problem from a scaled-down large one. The best party catering for eight or twelve people is usually not a buffet at all — a buffet needs 20 guests to make sense and looks sparse below that — but a plated or family-style dinner cooked in your kitchen, which carries no minimum headcount and starts at AED 700 per person. Between those two, a drop-off spread from AED 90 a head works from 10 guests upward, subject to the AED 900 minimum order.

Three party catering ideas travel well in a Dubai apartment or a small villa. A grazing table does the work of a buffet in a fraction of the space and needs nobody tending it. A single live station — a small grill, a pasta pan, a shawarma spit — gives a small room its focal point without four chefs in a galley kitchen. And a family-style Indian spread, with the curries, breads and rice landing on the table together, suits a small party better than plated courses, because everyone eats at once and nobody waits. Cheap party catering, if that is the brief, comes from three honest trade-offs: fewer dishes, drop-off instead of staffed service, and a shorter service window. Cutting the quality of the ingredients is the one that shows.

On the shawarma spit, which version you get matters more than the menu does, because that is the venue's decision rather than ours. At a villa the gas spit runs outdoors at ground level, cylinder upright on a firm base and clear of windows and air intakes. Inside an apartment it is the electric spit: Emaar's vertical-community rules bar residents from storing or using LPG cylinders anywhere in the unit or the community, and prohibit "barbecues, grills, or any cooking equipment of any kind" on balconies and terraces — so the electric unit goes beside the kitchen extract on its own socket, with the service lift booked and the building's sign-off in hand. On a yacht neither version sails, because no extra gas cylinder may be brought aboard under D‑Marin's Dubai marina rules (Art. 53.1(a)); there the cone is cooked in a licensed partner kitchen, carried hot-held and shaved to order at a carving station on deck, which is the part guests gather round anyway. On a rooftop terrace the gas spit is out, and the reason is written down: the UAE Fire and Life Safety Code (Table 11.1) keeps LPG cylinders off any roof or terrace, and above 90 m no LPG reaches the roof at all, so the tower height gets checked before gas is quoted. The electric spit takes its place, on working extraction and, under any covered section, a grease-rated hood with suppression. A desert camp is the straightforward one: the spit runs in the open, and what bites there is the enclosure rather than the fuel — nothing solid-fuelled goes inside a tent or an enclosed majlis, so the cook line sits outside it and the ash and coals leave with the caterer.

new_paragraphs: How much does catering cost for a party in Dubai?

From AED 120 per person for a buffet, AED 90 for a drop-off spread, AED 150 for BBQ, live stations or canapes, and AED 700 to AED 950 for a plated private-chef dinner. Fixed packages run AED 1,200 to 5,500. Staffing and rentals are quoted as separate lines.
What does it cost to cater a party for 50?

Multiply the format tier by 50 and add 5% VAT: from AED 120 a head for a buffet, AED 150 with live stations or canapes, AED 700 to AED 950 plated. At 50 guests you are above every minimum, so staffing and rentals are what move the total after that.
Do you do small party catering?

Yes. Below 20 guests a buffet stops making sense, so a plated or family-style dinner in your own kitchen is usually the better small party format, from AED 700 per person with no minimum headcount. A drop-off spread from AED 90 a head works from 10 guests, subject to the AED 900 minimum order.
What's included in party catering?
Included is menu design, a vetted chef, service staff where needed, all equipment, setup and full cleanup: a complete service, not food delivery alone.
How do I hire and book party catering?
Share your date, guest count and venue; we send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day, then a deposit holds your date.
Can you cater a corporate party?
Yes — corporate party catering is one of our core formats, with menus and timing built around launches, team events and awards moments.
Do you offer a private party chef at home?
Yes, a private party chef can cook in your own kitchen for intimate home catering, from a plated dinner to a relaxed grazing spread.
What party menu options are available?

Options span canapés and finger food, grazing tables, live stations, buffet or plated menus across Arabic, Italian, Mediterranean, Asian and Indian cuisines, with halal, vegan and allergen-aware choices.
Is affordable party catering possible in Dubai?
Affordable party catering is possible by adjusting menu, format and staffing; grazing and buffet styles usually cost less per head than plated multi-course service.
Which areas of Dubai do you serve?
We serve all of Dubai — Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Downtown, Business Bay, Deira, Emirates Hills and beyond — as a full-service party catering company.
For party catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

Book at least 72 hours ahead for a standard catering package and 48 hours for a private-chef dinner; live stations and multi-staff parties want 3 to 5 days, larger productions 7 to 14.

Plan on roughly 3 hours of service, and add 5% VAT to the total.
